# Martin 2019 Enriques source

*Enriques surfaces with finite automorphism group in positive characteristic*,
Algebraic Geometry 6 (2019), 592–649:
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.14231/AG-2019-027), [arXiv 1703.08419](https://arxiv.org/abs/1703.08419).

| Retained input | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `Martin2019.pdf` | `7831fbf14ed90f4a30eec68a989dce660724e6384bd1da3f108d373929b905a9` |

The historical transfer uses the Main Theorem (PDF p.3), Table 1 (pp. 4–5)
and labelled source figures. Exact matrices come from Shimada's arrays;
they are not digitized from the figures. The required `.bbl` remains;
disposable upstream TeX build sidecars need not be restored.
